mapper.insert: MERGE INTO CHB_MST_COUNTER_PARTY a USING ( SELECT #{uuid,jdbcType=VARCHAR} UUID, #{counterId,jdbcType=VARCHAR} COUNTER_ID, #{counterType,jdbcType=VARCHAR} COUNTER_TYPE, #{counterName,jdbcType=VARCHAR} COUNTER_NAME, #{counterType1,jdbcType=VARCHAR} COUNTER_TYPE1, #{counterType2,jdbcType=VARCHAR} COUNTER_TYPE2, #{dataSource,jdbcType=VARCHAR} DATA_SOURCE, #{status,jdbcType=VARCHAR} STATUS, #{remark,jdbcType=VARCHAR} REMARK, #{errMsg,jdbcType=VARCHAR} ERR_MSG, #{createUser,jdbcType=VARCHAR} CREATE_USER, #{createDept,jdbcType=VARCHAR} CREATE_DEPT, #{createTime,jdbcType=TIMESTAMP} CREATE_TIME, #{updateUser,jdbcType=VARCHAR} UPDATE_USER, #{updateTime,jdbcType=TIMESTAMP} UPDATE_TIME FROM DUAL )b ON (a.COUNTER_ID = b.COUNTER_ID) WHEN MATCHED THEN UPDATE SET a.COUNTER_TYPE = b.COUNTER_TYPE, a.COUNTER_NAME = b.COUNTER_NAME, a.COUNTER_TYPE1 = b.COUNTER_TYPE1, a.COUNTER_TYPE2 = b.COUNTER_TYPE2, a.DATA_SOURCE = b.DATA_SOURCE, a.STATUS = b.STATUS, a.REMARK = b.REMARK, a.ERR_MSG = b.ERR_MSG, a.UPDATE_USER = b.UPDATE_USER, a.UPDATE_TIME = b.UPDATE_TIME WHEN NOT MATCHED THEN INSERT ( UUID, COUNTER_ID, COUNTER_TYPE, COUNTER_NAME, COUNTER_TYPE1, COUNTER_TYPE2, DATA_SOURCE, STATUS, REMARK, ERR_MSG, CREATE_USER, CREATE_DEPT, CREATE_TIME, UPDATE_USER, UPDATE_TIME ) VALUES( b.UUID, b.COUNTER_ID, b.COUNTER_TYPE, b.COUNTER_NAME, b.COUNTER_TYPE1, b.COUNTER_TYPE2, b.DATA_SOURCE, b.STATUS, b.REMARK, b.ERR_MSG, b.CREATE_USER, b.CREATE_DEPT, b.CREATE_TIME, b.UPDATE_USER, b.UPDATE_TIME )
mapper.update:
update CHB_MST_COUNTER_PARTY set STATUS = 'E', COUNTER_ID= #{counterId}, COUNTER_TYPE= #{counterType}, COUNTER_NAME=#{counterName}, REMARK=#{remark}, COUNTER_TYPE1= #{counterType1}, COUNTER_TYPE2= #{counterType2}, UPDATE_USER = #{updateUser}, UPDATE_TIME = #{updateTime}
UUID = #{uuid}
mapper.select:
select UUID uuid, STATUS statusValid, 'INFO' info, COUNTER_TYPE counterType, COUNTER_ID counterId, COUNTER_NAME counterName, COUNTER_NAME counterName1, COUNTER_NAME counterName5, COUNTER_TYPE2 counterType2, REMARK remark from CHB_MST_COUNTER_PARTY B
B.UUID = #{uuid}

select UUID uuid, status statusValid, 'ERROR' info, COUNTER_TYPE counterType, COUNTER_ID counterId, COUNTER_NAME counterName, COUNTER_NAME counterName1, COUNTER_NAME counterName5, COUNTER_TYPE2 counterType2, ERR_MSG errMsg, ORG_DATA orgData from CHB_MST_COUNTER_PARTY_ERRODATA A
A.UUID = #{uuid}
SELECT ASSET_NAME FROM CHB_ASSET_INFO where ASSET_CODE = #{assetCode}

SELECT distinct(COUNTER_NAME) code, COUNTER_NAME name, COUNTER_NAME shortName, COUNTER_NAME hidCode FROM MST_CUSTOMER_INFO
COUNTER_NAME LIKE CONCAT('%',#{search}, '%')

select PROD_NAME id, PROD_NAME text from CHB_PRD_BASEINFO where 1=1
AND (PROD_ID like concat_ws('','%',#{search},'%') OR PROD_NAME like concat_ws('','%',#{search},'%'))
and PROD_NAME = #{initValue}
order by PROD_ID
SELECT CUSTOMER_ID FROM MST_CUSTOMER_INFO WHERE CUSTOMER_NAME=#{counterName} and rownum = 1
SELECT PROD_ID FROM CHB_PRD_BASEINFO WHERE PROD_NAME=#{counterName} and rownum=1
